name: exit-fade-hierarchy
title: Exit Fade Hierarchy
description: Content exits in reverse importance order: the least important elements fade first, headings hold longest — a choreography where the eye keeps its anchor while everything else dissolves around it.
designRules:
# Design System

Genre: Editorial
Macrostructure: Stack
Density: Medium
Shape: Sharp
Motion: Subtle
Typography: Grotesk
Color: Monochrome

## Rules

- Exit Sequence: the interaction model is part of the design, not an add-on.
- Reduced motion replaces animation with a state change; nothing is hidden behind motion.
- The component composes through `cn` and never hardcodes colours.

## Avoid

- Reskinning this resource and republishing it under a new name.
- Adding shadows or radii that contradict its shape language.
